civo_mat: Walter Mat came up the line in the rain with a photograph gone soft at the edges and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
One of the first hundred, Walter Mat was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.
Walter Mat caught a falling mug with his foot. Saving the mug was impressive; retrieving the foot without spilling it required assistance.
The transfer made Walter Mat a sapper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.
The last of the jam was shared by scraping it onto a biscuit. Walter Mat approved the method.
living_with_wild_wolves: Emil Wolves came from Stoneyford, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
roman_askey_: Jonas "Owl" Askey unpacked a key to a house that is no longer there at R-F13. A neighbour shifted a bag to make room without asking what it was.
Jonas "Owl" Askey's First Wave ribbon drew a question at supper. He remembered the queue at the depot more clearly than the speech.
Jonas "Owl" Askey got a letter from Ilse. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
